name: bhavya-portfolio
description: A modern, animated developer portfolio built with TypeScript, Vite, HTML, and CSS to showcase my technical skills, blockchain projects, certifications, and professional journey. Deployed using Vercel.

paragraphs: A modern, dark-themed personal portfolio showcasing my technical skills, blockchain projects, certifications, and journey as a B.Tech Computer Science student specializing in Blockchain Technology.
This portfolio serves as my professional online presence, bringing together my projects, technical knowledge, certifications, and contact information in one place.
I built it to strengthen my frontend development skills, present my work professionally, and explore modern development and deployment workflows.
features: Modern UI: Dark theme with emerald-green accents.
Animated Design: Orbit rings, floating technology labels, and network-inspired visual elements.
About Section: Introduction and professional background.
Skills Section: Programming languages, blockchain technologies, development tools, and computer science fundamentals.
Projects Section: Highlights of my blockchain-based projects.
